methodology: Price-to-rent, property tax, and buying and selling costs are the September 2026 Global Property Guide figures for an owner-occupied home across the IMF 2025 top-20 economies by nominal GDP. Property tax is already an effective rate on market value, including taxes originally charged on rent. South Korea price-to-rent uses Numbeo 2026 because GPG does not cover Korea. Housing home prices and monthly service charges are curated local-currency mid-market defaults by dwelling type (apartment / townhouse / detached), imported from Data/housing-defaults spreadsheets. Loan term, PMI, maintenance, and insurance baselines are curated owner-occupied defaults. Every catalog field lists provenance in sourcesByField as {name, url, asOf?} for point-in-time static figures, or {name, url, periodLabel?} for market series. Mortgage rates, rent growth, and home-price appreciation store only rate here as seeds; their periodLabel lives in sourcesByField. Publish merge order per market field is live fetch, then this seed, then the previous published catalog. Live observations keep their own source metadata and period; seed provenance and period come from sourcesByField.
